description: This file defines the OA_Dal class, a data abstraction layer for database operations in the Revive Adserver project. It includes methods for database connection handling, data object factory methods, batch inserts, and SQL generation tailored for different database types.

classes.name: OA_Dal
classes.description: A data abstraction layer class providing database connection, data object factory, batch insert, and SQL utility methods for the Revive Adserver project.

methods.name: _getDbh
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection object.

methods.name: factoryDO
methods.description: Creates and initializes a DB_DataObject for a specified table.

methods.name: checkIfDoExists
methods.description: Checks if a DataObject class file exists for a given table.

methods.name: staticGetDO
methods.description: Retrieves a pre-loaded DataObject for a table with specified key/value.

methods.name: staticDuplicate
methods.description: Duplicates a row in a specified table.

methods.name: factoryDAL
methods.description: Loads the appropriate MAX_Dal_Admin class for a table.

methods.name: getTablePrefix
methods.description: Returns the table prefix from configuration.

methods.name: _setupDataObjectOptions
methods.description: Configures DataObject options, including schema and class locations.

methods.name: createTemporaryTableFromSelect
methods.description: Generates SQL to create a temporary table based on database type.

methods.name: quoteInterval
methods.description: Returns SQL syntax for an interval value depending on database type.

methods.name: isValidDate
methods.description: Checks if a date string is valid and not empty.

methods.name: isNullDate
methods.description: Checks if a date string represents an 'empty' date.

methods.name: batchInsert
methods.description: Performs batch insert using LOAD DATA INFILE or COPY, with fallback to plain inserts.

methods.name: _batchInsertMySQL
methods.description: Performs batch insert for MySQL using LOAD DATA LOCAL INFILE.

methods.name: _batchInsertPgSQL
methods.description: Performs batch insert for PostgreSQL using COPY FROM.

methods.name: batchInsertPlain
methods.description: Performs batch insert with multiple plain INSERT statements.

methods.name: enableLoadDataInfile
methods.description: Enables or disables LOAD DATA INFILE for MySQL.
